title: Great little half day trip!
text: If you like to be a little adventurous,  this trip is for you. Not only do you get to explore lovely Monserrat, but you get to see some syunning views on the small hike. After exploring the monastery,  you take the funicular up and then walk back down. The walk is mostly downhill and doable if you have a basic level of fitness. Jordi, our guide, was very good and looked after us well on a very hot day. He was full of interesting facts and stories and made the day extra special!
author: Nilanjana_C

title: Incomparable views!
text: Our guides Juan and Frank took wonderful care of us on our 2+ hour hike. We appreciated the history and nature color they gave to our drive there and walk up and down the mountain. Be advised the hike is rather steep and the way down is rocky with steps that are far apart.
author: Kristi_S

title: A must on your list
text: Frank is warm, funny, and knowledgeable.  This was my 2nd time doing this tour with Frank. A must on your list
author: Jen_W

title: We loved Jesus! He was knowledgeable and so fun
text: Jesus was great! He showed us the sights, was so well planned, and didn’t rush us one bit. He was full of great information
author: Madeleine S

title: Montserrat was...
text:
Montserrat was breathtaking!! This tour made it so easy, loved being picked up in the city and being told about some of the history of Barcelona on the drive and also learning about Montserrat 
We were there on November 7th and although it was a sunny day it was very cold so layer up for sure! Worth being cold for a few hours to see the beautiful landscape 
Also loved the shops and local market afterwards
author: Michelle_B

title: Super nice tour with a...
text: Super nice tour with a guide named Gorge (hope I spell it right). No need to be afraid of hiking, because the most of the way is downhill. The tour is for a group of max 8 people, which is just perfect.
author: Yelena_K

title: Wonderfuk tour! A great...
text: Wonderfuk tour! A great way to experience Montserrat and the monastery in a few hours. The hike is 90% downhill so not difficult.
author: Trevor_M

title: Delightful experience
text: jorge(George) was a delight. He was informative about himself, Barcelona and the Montserrat history. He cared about what he was sharing. He was very patient with the other 4 people who booked at our time. He gave more than 100%. My friend and I enjoyed the time for sure.
author: Karen_H

title: Highly recommend
text: Jesus was a fabulous guide - so thoughtful, informative and energetic. Touring Monserrat including the gorgeous surrounding trails is highly recommended
author: Jean_S

title: Great tour - impressive unique mountain
text: My favourites were the views of the mountsides from the trail accessed by the tram. The cool crisp air was invigorating.
author: Richard_C
